title: Private Cluster Emergency Control Panel — rollback, isolate, and repair flows
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a consolidated "Emergency Control Panel" UI for Private/VPC clusters that lets operators quickly isolate affected nodes, perform controlled rollbacks, and launch guided repair playbooks while showing immediate cost and SLA impact. The panel should be accessible from cluster status pages and offer keyboard-driven actions, confirmable BCP-safe steps (canary revert, throttled rollback), and context-aware safeguards for private deployments (VPC routing checks, KMS access validation).
goals: Enable on-call engineers to take safe, auditable emergency actions (isolate, rollback, repair) from a single surface
Surface immediate cost delta and SLA impact before action with tokenized estimation per action
Integrate with rollout policies (canary, percentage based, time-window) and Dedicated capacity controls
Provide clear post-action verification steps and links to troubleshooting artifacts
non_goals: Replace full runbook engine (we will link out to existing runbook/incident docs)
Handle cross-region disaster recovery orchestration (out of scope for this ticket)
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fidelity Figma prototype for panel screens: closed, open, confirm, progress, and result states
Prototype includes cost delta estimator and SLA impact badge on each action
Accessibility: panel keyboard shortcuts documented and screen-reader labels included
Handoff package (components, tokens, interaction spec) delivered to Eng with acceptance walkthrough
Usability testing: 5 on-call participants, success rate >= 80% on scripted rollback protocol
design_decisions: Show cost delta as a 3-line summary (estimated token cost, estimated instance-hours, predicted SLA % change) rather than raw dollars to avoid region/contract complexity
Require a two-step confirmation for irreversible actions: select scope (node(s)/cluster/route), then confirm with typed acknowledgement
Default to conservative rollout strategies (canary 5% for 10m) for all rollback actions in Private clusters; allow override with elevated permissions
Embed non-blocking pre-checks (VPC route validation, KMS access, CIDR conflicts) and surface failures inline before allowing action
tradeoffs_and_risks: Combining multiple emergency actions in one panel reduces context switching but increases UI density; we mitigate by progressive disclosure
Estimating cost and SLA impact is inherently fuzzy — we provide ranges and link to the detailed estimator rather than hard guarantees
Keyboard-first workflows may have a steeper learning curve for new users; include inline coachmarks and a quick 'playback' of previous actions
notes: Related PM ticket: PM-4021 (incident response improvements for Private clusters)

Backend hooks required: /cluster/{id}/actions/isolate, /cluster/{id}/actions/rollback, /cluster/{id}/actions/repair (ENG-7024 owns API); a lightweight estimator service (ENG-7139) will return cost/SLA deltas
This design must use existing audit-log schema so every emergency action is traceable with actor, timestamp, and inputs
Coordinate with Security for KMS/privilege checks before GA (security_review_required=true)

As a platform engineer, I want to preview the cost and SLA impact of a rollback so I can communicate tradeoffs to a product owner before executing
As an operator in a regulated environment, I need every emergency action to be auditable and gated by privilege checks so we meet compliance
